description: Defines the feedback audit sampling framework (evaluation-of-evaluation): sampling unit, triggers, deterministic rates, risk strata, evidence requirements, human-review fields, failure categories, and version provenance. Operation deferred; rate/criteria/reviewer pool remain a Researcher decision.

statements.statement: The sampling unit is one feedback delivery instance (feedback_id), audited with its full evidence chain.
Selection is deterministic and reproducible (stable hash of feedback_id, versioned sampler rule audit-sampler-v0.1.0).
High-risk strata (strength claims, corpus grounding, longitudinal statements, low-confidence admissions, fallback comparisons) are sampled at 100%.
The default systematic rate is 5% (medium stratum); rate, criteria, and reviewer pool are a Researcher decision and change only through policy amendment.
Every sampled unit requires the full pipeline version chain and evidence ids; missing evidence makes the unit not_auditable, never inferred.
Human review reuses the research review contracts (decision/confidence/reason_code/comment/guideline_version, target_type=FEEDBACK).

Failure categories are a closed vocabulary (evidence_not_grounded, unsupported_claim, claim_template_violation, fabricated_evidence, attribution_error, unavailability_mishandled, leakage_or_domain_violation, pii_exposure, provenance_missing, other).
Audit sampling is evaluation-of-evaluation; audit outcomes never become learner-outcome measures.
No learner-facing feedback is built by this foundation; operation is deferred to Horizon 2.
